notes.title: Free Weekend and launch!
notes.notes:
We are still alive!
Puppet Fever is soon coming a point where we will exit Early Access and launch 1.0! We celebrate this a bit early with a free weekend, so make sure to tell your friends to try it out!

notes.title: v 0.7.5.a Text hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug with text not being displayed when playing on a 4k resolution

notes.title: v 0.7.5 Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Added more words
- Added Mixer Streaming game mode
- Improved animation for showing the correct word
- Added Swedish language
- Removed the grip button as input on Oculus
- Added a play again option in the gallery
- Revised inventory screen and icons
- Added sound feedback to several character puppets
- Several fixes to wordcard icons and quick inventory
- Bug fixes

Mixer Game Mode
Play with up to 12 players online using Mixer. In this game mode a single Puppet Master can host a Puppet Fever session and play in real time with friends using Mixer. The audience players will type guesses as they join the game from mixer.com, an Xbox One or the Mixer app for smartphones.

notes.title: v 0.7.1.a Mixed Reality fix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where the game would be stuck on the change player animation when using a Mixed Reality headset.

notes.title: 0.7.1 Update: Mixer Chat and dedicated Puppet Master!
notes.notes:
Changelog:

- Added Mixer chat support in VR, play over livestream!
- Mixer chat does not yet support emotes, but we're working on it.
- Added dedicated Puppet Master mode (no player swapping, perfect for livestreams!)
- Expanded options in game setup.
- Feedback on some menu buttons.
- Tweaked scaling of some puppets.
- More frequent intermissions during long games.
- Added additional info signs regarding controllers.
- Changed the font on info signs in order to improve readability in VR.

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Early Access of our first VR game on Steam! Make sure you gather some friends to really get a feel for how we meant the game to be played. And if you feel like giving us some feedback, please leave a review, post in the Steam discussion group or on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/virtualreality/comments/8ddk4r/we_made_puppet_fever_a_vr_party_game_wed_love_to/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/PuppetFever]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/puppetfever/]Facebook[/url]. 

We're listening and are happy to engage in a discussion about all your thoughts about the game. Happy puppeteering this weekend!
